headline: Virginia requires data centers to pay for their own power lines
summary: Who will pay for the data center power lines going up in Virginia?  The commonwealth's State Corporation Commission decided Wednesday that the billions of dollars being spent to build power lines to serve data centers in northern Virginia will not fall on ratepayers.  Regulators agreed with Governor Abigail Spanberger, who last month called for the commission to put the onus on the companies behind the large energy usage rather than spreading it out to everyday Virginians.

headline: SCC orders Dominion to develop tariff to assign more transmission costs to data centers
summary: More of the cost to build the high-voltage transmission lines that serve as power highways across the state could soon be covered by data centers, after a recent decision by state regulators.
